task: Repair the plain-field binding use-inference regression without allowing implicit field extraction.
observation: The failing source `b = s.frontier` was parsed as Stmt::Kind::Assign, not Let/Var. The Assign case set the field source's provisional effect to CONSUME but recognized only local identifiers and indexed projections as alias sources, so no per-definition use fact was retained before the field diagnostic ran. A direct stack/call-site trace resolved the misleading later Let/Var inference path.
impact: The fix needed to add non-indexed field places to the existing Assign-case use-inference path; adding inference only to Let/Var had no effect on the requested reproductions.

resolution.summary: Assign now records the field root and infers READ versus CONSUME from the new local's uses. READ cases print 3 in Fast Debug and native; consuming use remains rejected at line 9 with the unchanged diagnostic.
